newsitem.title: USA: Cyclone Gillian dissipates off Queensland coast.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone Gillian dissipates off Queensland coast.

text.p: Tropical Cyclone Gillian has dissipated off the coast of Queensland, Australia but is still bringing heavy rainfall to the region, private forecaster Weather Services Corp (WSC) said.
The remnants of Gillian will continue to move inland and it could still cause locally heavy rains and flash floods but damage is not expected to be heavy.

A slow moving front to the south will pick up the moisture brought in by Gillian. This combination could lead to locally heavy rains and flash floods in interior sections of Queensland and New South Wales. Cotton and sorghum crops may be affected, WSC said.
